stem:
Anjali finds four things near her school garden and wants to decide which is living.

Which choice uses the shared life characteristics correctly?

options.text: A dry, dormant mustard seed is dead because it is not moving or growing right now.
A rooted flowering hibiscus is living because it shows life processes such as growth, needing food, and responding to surroundings.
A rooted flowering hibiscus is non-living because plants cannot move from place to place.
A toy car rolling down a slope is living because it shows movement.

teacher.key_rationale: Living status depends on the shared set of life characteristics, not one visible sign such as movement. A flowering plant shows those processes; a dormant seed is not simply dead; a rolling toy is non-living.
